== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Phoenix]] Song is a complex and ethereal melody that serves as both an internal state and a powerful auditory phenomenon. It manifests as a musical force that can be summoned, allowing an individual to perceive sounds with heightened clarity. The song is characterized by a combination of various elements, including the essence of the [[Sword Icon]], the sharp silence associated with [[Eithan]]'s combat methods, and an underlying sense of bloodlust. When active, the melody can influence a person's movements, driving them to dance to its rhythm and empowering their weaponry with red-and-[[silver madra]]. The song is deeply connected to The Phoenix{{!}}the Phoenix, an entity capable of taking a human-like form with scarlet wings and a musical voice. This connection is further emphasized by the presence of the [[Bleeding Phoenix]], an influence that can spread through the environment and merge with various living beings.}}

== Waybound ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-12-waybound|[[The Phoenix]] Song is a [[technique]] summoned by [[Yerin]] that resides within her. This phenomenon eventually reaches a powerful crescendo during its use. When active, the [[technique]] possesses the ability to strip [[Remnants]] of their [[madra]], memories, and will.}}
